newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures closed mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures closed mostly firmer.

text.p: UK grain futures closed mostly firmer as sterling shed earlier gains against the dollar, and retreated from high's seen on Friday versus the mark.
"Its been a day of good volatility, although volume wasn't quite as high as that on Friday," one trader said.
Wheat futures ended 0.50-0.85 sterling up, after trading some 947 lots. Most active traded month of Jan with 331 lots, traded last at 99.35 sterling, up from a low trade of 97.50.
Barley futures were basically ignored trading just 71 lots. At the close they stood 0.25 sterling either side of Friday's finish.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures were completely ignored.
The delivered market found the volatility of sterling too much, which resulted in a few trades to cover immediate needs but otherwise saw traders siedlined.
